literal: Showing as if it exists in the mind, to a person, wisdom becomes that which exists in the company.
translation: Though a person's wisdom appears to originate from their own mind, it actually takes the nature of the company they keep.
modern: ஒருவருடைய அறிவு அவருடைய மனத்திலேயே இயல்பாக இருப்பது போலத் தோன்றினாலும், உண்மையில் அது அவர் சேர்ந்திருக்கும் கூட்டத்தின் தன்மையைப் பொறுத்தே அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the profound influence of one's associates on their intellect. While a person's wisdom might appear to be an independent quality originating from their own mind, it is fundamentally shaped by their social circle. The word 'இனத்து' (in the company) contrasts with 'மனத்து' (in the mind) to emphasize that external associations override internal disposition. Therefore, keeping good company is essential for cultivating true wisdom.
